fieldData.main-content:
We launched the first Radix Swag Contest a few weeks ago, where our community members battled it out to design a Radix-themed T-shirt or a Hoodie. 

With over 100 designs submitted to the contest, the judging process wasn’t easy. Our community has the most outstanding creators with an eye for detail and artistic talent that is unmatched! All submissions were evaluated on their creativity, originality, and community response. Thank you to everyone who took part! 

To celebrate the grand opening of the Radix Swag Store, we are now launching it together with the grand winner of the contest. 

The first products: Olympia Cerby Community Design T-shirt & Hoodie

This beautifully colored, creative piece by the community artist Lucile Dufau tells a story of a puppy Cerberus at Olympia - the city of Statue of Zeus, and the name of the first Radix Public Network. Lucile’s design was highly rated by both our judges and the community. 

‍

The products will be listed for purchase tomorrow, 16th June, 18:00 UTC.

‍

This will be a special limited edition (only 10 each), a sought-out masterpiece for years to come. Don’t miss out on the chance to get an exclusive part of Radix history! 

The Radix Swag Store will have all the essential products from your favourite crypto project  - hoodies, t-shirts, hats, mugs, and even socks! Stay tuned as more get listed during the lead-up to mainnet. We have a new contest round coming soon. 

Do you want an exclusive swag package from Radix? Follow our social media and participate in our upcoming community events. 

‍
